svg.title: Jco core dependency layout
svg.desc: Dependencies flow from top to bottom into jco. Twenty projects and crate groups are connected by twenty-eight arrows. Dashed connectors show build-time generation or vendoring. Embedded diagrams.net XML preserves editable nodes, groups, labels, and connectors.
